Class JustEtfUDFValueResolver

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.resolver.JustEtfUDFValueResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
IUDFValueResolver
@Component public class JustEtfUDFValueResolver extends Object implements IUDFValueResolver
Reads a figure of an ETF from its German justETF profile, which is addressed by the ISIN of the security. The argument names the figure: TER is the total expense ratio in percent per year, FUND_SIZE the fund size in millions of the fund currency, both for decimal fields. ACTIVE is true for an ETF whose securities are selected actively, false for an index ETF, for a boolean field. justETF marks an active ETF with the investment concept "Aktiv gemanagt" and a label on the profile; its own classification applies, so an ETF on an option strategy index such as a covered call index counts as not active. The figures are read from the elements that carry a data-testid on the profile page, not from running text. An ISIN justETF does not know is answered with a redirect to the search page; that and a page that does not carry the ISIN count as unknown. Only the ISIN leaves the instance. A profile page is about 500 KB, so the parsed figures of one ISIN are kept for a few minutes: a field for the TER and one for the fund size then cost one request. Requests are separated by at least one second.
